command: from pathlib import Path; import json; from experiments.balanced_record_context.run import sha,sources; w=Path("../a8_work"); p=w/"frozen_fit.lock.json"; assert not p.exists(); plan=json.loads((w/"a8/plan.json").read_text()); assert sources()==plan["source_hashes"]; assert json.loads((w/"fit_process.json").read_text())["exit_code"]==0; lock={str(x.relative_to(w)):sha(x) for x in sorted((w/"a8").rglob("*")) if x.is_file()}; p.write_text(json.dumps(lock,indent=2)+"\n"); print(len(lock),"fit files locked")
